The website goal

Help visitors find
their next step.

Help visitors understand the hospital’s services, find relevant doctor information and see how to take the next step. The structure connects departments with individual care topics and contact options.

My role in the work

Marketing thinking.
AI-assisted execution.

I planned the website and applied my digital marketing and SEO fundamentals. ChatGPT and Codex helped build it; I reviewed the output, identified issues and directed corrections.

I guided what to build, how the information should connect and what needed another review. The work includes planning, SEO direction and quality review.

Inside the approach

The decisions behind the pages.

01

Organise care around the visitor

Department pages connect to specific concerns, such as kidney stones. This gives visitors a route from a broad need to more relevant information.

02

Make the next step visible

Doctor details, consultation links and call options sit alongside service information, so visitors can see where to go next.

03

Plan for different screens

The department layout adapts from desktop to mobile. These are actual screenshots of the live site, with the mobile contact options visible.

One journey, connected

From a department
to a specific concern.

The urology page links to dedicated care topics. The kidney stone page brings together focused information, doctor details and consultation options.

This is the structure in practice: help visitors explore, understand and find a way to contact the hospital.
